name: @health/shared
//build: The Vercel API function resolves @health/shared through the node_modules workspace symlink and never transpiles it, so the default export condition points at pre-built JS. The types condition still points at the .ts source so tsc's bundler resolution keeps full type fidelity.

scripts.build: esbuild schema/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:zod --external:date-fns --outfile=dist/schema.js && esbuild data/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:zod --external:date-fns --outfile=dist/data.js && esbuild insights/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=node22 --external:zod --external:date-fns --outfile=dist/insights.js
